1) The durable handoff points to evidence files that are not in this PR. docs/issue-111-handoff.md links evidence/issue-111/npm-test-sandbox.log, evidence/issue-111/npm-test.log (the 723-test full run) and evidence/issue-111/batch-tests.log (the 15 test results). The diff adds only implementation.sha256, rehearsal-acceptance.json and rehearsal.json.gz under docs/evidence/issue-111/. These three logs are the only retained record of the full-suite and sandbox-failure results the handoff cites, so the links are dead and the report of remaining limits is unverifiable. Commit the three logs, or remove the claims and links and state where the output is kept. The retained output must be complete and unmodified, per ADR 0001.

2) The handoff's delivery status is stale for the delivered head. It says the implementation 'remains a working-tree change', that the exact-head review and remote CI are still outstanding, and that gh auth is invalid so CI verification is blocked. The PR head 9661ba4 is committed and has a green CI run (#39893058022). Update the handoff to name the delivered SHA and its CI run. Say plainly that independent review is still performed by the guarded pipeline rather than by the local failed Claude attempts. Also state that implementation.sha256 was computed over the tested contents and re-check that it still matches src/milestone-summary.js, src/cli.js and test/milestone-batches.test.js at this head.

3) Minor: the out-of-scope ready-labeled #202 is reported as 'waiting', with the reason 'No receipt; publish and obtain exact owner scope approval'. The lastAdmission decision is NEEDS_APPROVAL and the issue was never in the grant, so an owner reading the summary could take it as pending work. Mark or explain it as a non-grant issue that was blocked (denied) so the 'denied' state in the acceptance criteria is actually shown. Add a test assertion on that status.

findings.summary:
1) The durable handoff points to evidence files that are not in this PR. docs/issue-111-handoff.md links evidence/issue-111/npm-test-sandbox.log, evidence/issue-111/npm-test.log (the 723-test full run) and evidence/issue-111/batch-tests.log (the 15 test results). The diff adds only implementation.sha256, rehearsal-acceptance.json and rehearsal.json.gz under docs/evidence/issue-111/. These three logs are the only retained record of the full-suite and sandbox-failure results the handoff cites, so the links are dead and the report of remaining limits is unverifiable. Commit the three logs, or remove the claims and links and state where the output is kept. The retained output must be complete and unmodified, per ADR 0001.

2) The handoff's delivery status is stale for the delivered head. It says the implementation 'remains a working-tree change', that the exact-head review and remote CI are still outstanding, and that gh auth is invalid so CI verification is blocked. The PR head 9661ba4 is committed and has a green CI run (#39893058022). Update the handoff to name the delivered SHA and its CI run. Say plainly that independent review is still performed by the guarded pipeline rather than by the local failed Claude attempts. Also state that implementation.sha256 was computed over the tested contents and re-check that it still matches src/milestone-summary.js, src/cli.js and test/milestone-batches.test.js at this head.

3) Minor: the out-of-scope ready-labeled #202 is reported as 'waiting', with the reason 'No receipt; publish and obtain exact owner scope approval'. The lastAdmission decision is NEEDS_APPROVAL and the issue was never in the grant, so an owner reading the summary could take it as pending work. Mark or explain it as a non-grant issue that was blocked (denied) so the 'denied' state in the acceptance criteria is actually shown. Add a test assertion on that status.

findings.summary:
1) The durable handoff points to evidence files that are not in this PR. docs/issue-111-handoff.md links evidence/issue-111/npm-test-sandbox.log, evidence/issue-111/npm-test.log (the 723-test full run) and evidence/issue-111/batch-tests.log (the 15 test results). The diff adds only implementation.sha256, rehearsal-acceptance.json and rehearsal.json.gz under docs/evidence/issue-111/. These three logs are the only retained record of the full-suite and sandbox-failure results the handoff cites, so the links are dead and the report of remaining limits is unverifiable. Commit the three logs, or remove the claims and links and state where the output is kept. The retained output must be complete and unmodified, per ADR 0001.

2) The handoff's delivery status is stale for the delivered head. It says the implementation 'remains a working-tree change', that the exact-head review and remote CI are still outstanding, and that gh auth is invalid so CI verification is blocked. The PR head 9661ba4 is committed and has a green CI run (#39893058022). Update the handoff to name the delivered SHA and its CI run. Say plainly that independent review is still performed by the guarded pipeline rather than by the local failed Claude attempts. Also state that implementation.sha256 was computed over the tested contents and re-check that it still matches src/milestone-summary.js, src/cli.js and test/milestone-batches.test.js at this head.

3) Minor: the out-of-scope ready-labeled #202 is reported as 'waiting', with the reason 'No receipt; publish and obtain exact owner scope approval'. The lastAdmission decision is NEEDS_APPROVAL and the issue was never in the grant, so an owner reading the summary could take it as pending work. Mark or explain it as a non-grant issue that was blocked (denied) so the 'denied' state in the acceptance criteria is actually shown. Add a test assertion on that status.

findings.summary:
1) The durable handoff points to evidence files that are not in this PR. docs/issue-111-handoff.md links evidence/issue-111/npm-test-sandbox.log, evidence/issue-111/npm-test.log (the 723-test full run) and evidence/issue-111/batch-tests.log (the 15 test results). The diff adds only implementation.sha256, rehearsal-acceptance.json and rehearsal.json.gz under docs/evidence/issue-111/. These three logs are the only retained record of the full-suite and sandbox-failure results the handoff cites, so the links are dead and the report of remaining limits is unverifiable. Commit the three logs, or remove the claims and links and state where the output is kept. The retained output must be complete and unmodified, per ADR 0001.

2) The handoff's delivery status is stale for the delivered head. It says the implementation 'remains a working-tree change', that the exact-head review and remote CI are still outstanding, and that gh auth is invalid so CI verification is blocked. The PR head 9661ba4 is committed and has a green CI run (#39893058022). Update the handoff to name the delivered SHA and its CI run. Say plainly that independent review is still performed by the guarded pipeline rather than by the local failed Claude attempts. Also state that implementation.sha256 was computed over the tested contents and re-check that it still matches src/milestone-summary.js, src/cli.js and test/milestone-batches.test.js at this head.

3) Minor: the out-of-scope ready-labeled #202 is reported as 'waiting', with the reason 'No receipt; publish and obtain exact owner scope approval'. The lastAdmission decision is NEEDS_APPROVAL and the issue was never in the grant, so an owner reading the summary could take it as pending work. Mark or explain it as a non-grant issue that was blocked (denied) so the 'denied' state in the acceptance criteria is actually shown. Add a test assertion on that status.

findings.summary:
1) The durable handoff points to evidence files that are not in this PR. docs/issue-111-handoff.md links evidence/issue-111/npm-test-sandbox.log, evidence/issue-111/npm-test.log (the 723-test full run) and evidence/issue-111/batch-tests.log (the 15 test results). The diff adds only implementation.sha256, rehearsal-acceptance.json and rehearsal.json.gz under docs/evidence/issue-111/. These three logs are the only retained record of the full-suite and sandbox-failure results the handoff cites, so the links are dead and the report of remaining limits is unverifiable. Commit the three logs, or remove the claims and links and state where the output is kept. The retained output must be complete and unmodified, per ADR 0001.

2) The handoff's delivery status is stale for the delivered head. It says the implementation 'remains a working-tree change', that the exact-head review and remote CI are still outstanding, and that gh auth is invalid so CI verification is blocked. The PR head 9661ba4 is committed and has a green CI run (#39893058022). Update the handoff to name the delivered SHA and its CI run. Say plainly that independent review is still performed by the guarded pipeline rather than by the local failed Claude attempts. Also state that implementation.sha256 was computed over the tested contents and re-check that it still matches src/milestone-summary.js, src/cli.js and test/milestone-batches.test.js at this head.

3) Minor: the out-of-scope ready-labeled #202 is reported as 'waiting', with the reason 'No receipt; publish and obtain exact owner scope approval'. The lastAdmission decision is NEEDS_APPROVAL and the issue was never in the grant, so an owner reading the summary could take it as pending work. Mark or explain it as a non-grant issue that was blocked (denied) so the 'denied' state in the acceptance criteria is actually shown. Add a test assertion on that status.

findings.summary:
1) The durable handoff points to evidence files that are not in this PR. docs/issue-111-handoff.md links evidence/issue-111/npm-test-sandbox.log, evidence/issue-111/npm-test.log (the 723-test full run) and evidence/issue-111/batch-tests.log (the 15 test results). The diff adds only implementation.sha256, rehearsal-acceptance.json and rehearsal.json.gz under docs/evidence/issue-111/. These three logs are the only retained record of the full-suite and sandbox-failure results the handoff cites, so the links are dead and the report of remaining limits is unverifiable. Commit the three logs, or remove the claims and links and state where the output is kept. The retained output must be complete and unmodified, per ADR 0001.

2) The handoff's delivery status is stale for the delivered head. It says the implementation 'remains a working-tree change', that the exact-head review and remote CI are still outstanding, and that gh auth is invalid so CI verification is blocked. The PR head 9661ba4 is committed and has a green CI run (#39893058022). Update the handoff to name the delivered SHA and its CI run. Say plainly that independent review is still performed by the guarded pipeline rather than by the local failed Claude attempts. Also state that implementation.sha256 was computed over the tested contents and re-check that it still matches src/milestone-summary.js, src/cli.js and test/milestone-batches.test.js at this head.

3) Minor: the out-of-scope ready-labeled #202 is reported as 'waiting', with the reason 'No receipt; publish and obtain exact owner scope approval'. The lastAdmission decision is NEEDS_APPROVAL and the issue was never in the grant, so an owner reading the summary could take it as pending work. Mark or explain it as a non-grant issue that was blocked (denied) so the 'denied' state in the acceptance criteria is actually shown. Add a test assertion on that status.

findings.summary:
1) The durable handoff points to evidence files that are not in this PR. docs/issue-111-handoff.md links evidence/issue-111/npm-test-sandbox.log, evidence/issue-111/npm-test.log (the 723-test full run) and evidence/issue-111/batch-tests.log (the 15 test results). The diff adds only implementation.sha256, rehearsal-acceptance.json and rehearsal.json.gz under docs/evidence/issue-111/. These three logs are the only retained record of the full-suite and sandbox-failure results the handoff cites, so the links are dead and the report of remaining limits is unverifiable. Commit the three logs, or remove the claims and links and state where the output is kept. The retained output must be complete and unmodified, per ADR 0001.

2) The handoff's delivery status is stale for the delivered head. It says the implementation 'remains a working-tree change', that the exact-head review and remote CI are still outstanding, and that gh auth is invalid so CI verification is blocked. The PR head 9661ba4 is committed and has a green CI run (#39893058022). Update the handoff to name the delivered SHA and its CI run. Say plainly that independent review is still performed by the guarded pipeline rather than by the local failed Claude attempts. Also state that implementation.sha256 was computed over the tested contents and re-check that it still matches src/milestone-summary.js, src/cli.js and test/milestone-batches.test.js at this head.

3) Minor: the out-of-scope ready-labeled #202 is reported as 'waiting', with the reason 'No receipt; publish and obtain exact owner scope approval'. The lastAdmission decision is NEEDS_APPROVAL and the issue was never in the grant, so an owner reading the summary could take it as pending work. Mark or explain it as a non-grant issue that was blocked (denied) so the 'denied' state in the acceptance criteria is actually shown. Add a test assertion on that status.

findings.summary:
1) The durable handoff points to evidence files that are not in this PR. docs/issue-111-handoff.md links evidence/issue-111/npm-test-sandbox.log, evidence/issue-111/npm-test.log (the 723-test full run) and evidence/issue-111/batch-tests.log (the 15 test results). The diff adds only implementation.sha256, rehearsal-acceptance.json and rehearsal.json.gz under docs/evidence/issue-111/. These three logs are the only retained record of the full-suite and sandbox-failure results the handoff cites, so the links are dead and the report of remaining limits is unverifiable. Commit the three logs, or remove the claims and links and state where the output is kept. The retained output must be complete and unmodified, per ADR 0001.

2) The handoff's delivery status is stale for the delivered head. It says the implementation 'remains a working-tree change', that the exact-head review and remote CI are still outstanding, and that gh auth is invalid so CI verification is blocked. The PR head 9661ba4 is committed and has a green CI run (#39893058022). Update the handoff to name the delivered SHA and its CI run. Say plainly that independent review is still performed by the guarded pipeline rather than by the local failed Claude attempts. Also state that implementation.sha256 was computed over the tested contents and re-check that it still matches src/milestone-summary.js, src/cli.js and test/milestone-batches.test.js at this head.

3) Minor: the out-of-scope ready-labeled #202 is reported as 'waiting', with the reason 'No receipt; publish and obtain exact owner scope approval'. The lastAdmission decision is NEEDS_APPROVAL and the issue was never in the grant, so an owner reading the summary could take it as pending work. Mark or explain it as a non-grant issue that was blocked (denied) so the 'denied' state in the acceptance criteria is actually shown. Add a test assertion on that status.

findings.summary:
1) The durable handoff points to evidence files that are not in this PR. docs/issue-111-handoff.md links evidence/issue-111/npm-test-sandbox.log, evidence/issue-111/npm-test.log (the 723-test full run) and evidence/issue-111/batch-tests.log (the 15 test results). The diff adds only implementation.sha256, rehearsal-acceptance.json and rehearsal.json.gz under docs/evidence/issue-111/. These three logs are the only retained record of the full-suite and sandbox-failure results the handoff cites, so the links are dead and the report of remaining limits is unverifiable. Commit the three logs, or remove the claims and links and state where the output is kept. The retained output must be complete and unmodified, per ADR 0001.

2) The handoff's delivery status is stale for the delivered head. It says the implementation 'remains a working-tree change', that the exact-head review and remote CI are still outstanding, and that gh auth is invalid so CI verification is blocked. The PR head 9661ba4 is committed and has a green CI run (#39893058022). Update the handoff to name the delivered SHA and its CI run. Say plainly that independent review is still performed by the guarded pipeline rather than by the local failed Claude attempts. Also state that implementation.sha256 was computed over the tested contents and re-check that it still matches src/milestone-summary.js, src/cli.js and test/milestone-batches.test.js at this head.

3) Minor: the out-of-scope ready-labeled #202 is reported as 'waiting', with the reason 'No receipt; publish and obtain exact owner scope approval'. The lastAdmission decision is NEEDS_APPROVAL and the issue was never in the grant, so an owner reading the summary could take it as pending work. Mark or explain it as a non-grant issue that was blocked (denied) so the 'denied' state in the acceptance criteria is actually shown. Add a test assertion on that status.
